buyer: The Danish Ministry of Defence Acquisition and Logistics Organisation
title: Acquisition of a Secure Voice Communication System (VCS) and appertaining sustainment
description:
1) General description of the Contract:
This contract award notice concerns DALO´s award of an Acquisition Contract, 
with a Sustainment Framework Agreement, for a VCS, including sustainment, i.e. 
development, implementation, maintenance and support during its life time (20 
years).
In order to facilitate both the acquisition and the sustainment, the procurement 
includes two main contractual agreements: an Acquisition Contract and a Sustainment Framework Agreement (together the “Contract”). These two agreements are mutually dependent and shall be seen together as a whole regulating the contractual relations between SAAB Danmark A/S and DALO.
2) The Acquisition Contract:
The VCS facilitate voice communication between ground operational centers and 
other ground based operational entities as well as communication to and from 
aircrafts and vessels. The VCS will be used intensively and on a continuous basis 
(24/7/365) by the Danish Defence, including and foremost the Royal Danish Navy in 
relation to maritime surface surveillance and the Royal Danish Air Force for air 
surveillance, air battle management and Command and Control.
Consequently, it is of utmost importance that the VCS and its functionalities operate with a high level of availability. Furthermore, in order for the VCS to efficiently contribute to the missions and operations within the span of tasks under the Danish Defence, the VCS have the following functionalities and characteristics:
The VCS shall be scalable in terms of the number of centers, users and radios, the 
types of radios and services. The VCS is to be installed in Denmark on approx. 40 
remote radio sites and 5 operational centers, one Test and School System, and one 
Reference System for reproduction of problems and test of software updates. Each 
radio site may have different types of radios allocated including HF, VHF, UHF and 
TETRA radios. Furthermore, the VCS shall integrate a voice recording system and a 
Cisco Call Manager based IP-telephone system operated by the Danish Defence (GFE).
The VCS shall be security accredited to the classification level NATO SECRET and 
the Danish classification level HEMMELIGT. It is noted that NATO SECRET and 
HEMMELIGT is two individual accreditation approvals.
The VCS’ primary function is to interconnect radios, telephone systems, intercom 
and public announcement systems. Besides the VCS’ primary function, the VCS 
shall be able to separate voice communication in minimum two security domains up 
to and including the classification levels NATO SECRET and HEMMELIGT.
The VCS shall have a dedicated management system. VCS system components 
shall be capable of being used in all locations with an available IP infrastructure, 
including satellite links with high latency. The VCS shall be based on End-to-End IP 
architecture. 
TEMPEST modified equipment in the VCS shall be compliant to NATO SDIP-27. The VCS will be using DALO’s own government furnished equipment (GFE), including IP-WAN, cryptographic devices and Voice Recorders and shall be designed to integrate a wide range of different types of radios. TEMPEST modified equipment is also required at selected locations of the VCS.
As part of the Contract, SAAB Danmark A/S shall deliver system documentation and technical maintenance documentation for the VCS. Furthermore, SAAB Danmark A/S shall deliver initial training and education for all kinds of users, including operators, system administrators and super-users.
3) The Sustainment Framework Agreement:
During the expected lifetime of the VCS, DALO shall be able to acquire development and repair services and maintenance, including the possibility to acquire spare parts as well as off site and on site technical support. As part of these deliverables, SAAB Danmark A/S shall ensure that the system documentation and the technical maintenance documentation are kept updated continuously. On request, DALO shall be able to acquire training and education for all kinds of users, including operators, system administrators and super-users, remote radio site technicians as well as tailor made courses. Furthermore, SAAB Danmark A/S shall host a Reference system at a location in Denmark.

title: Technical Assistance to the National Copernicus Capacity Support Action Programme for the Philippines (CopPhil)
description: The long-term sustainability of the national Copernicus programme for the Philippines will be supported by the provision of exchange of experts, researchers and graduate students from the Philippines to Europe and vice versa. This will facilitate transfer of knowledge and strengthen the uptake and evolution of Copernicus data and information. The TA will ensure a gender-balanced access to expertise exchange opportunities, PhD and MSc ERASMUS+ scholarships. The following results are envisaged through this TA : The awareness about benefits and limitations of Earth Observation-derived information is improved; Earth Observation/Geo-information skills and knowledge are strengthened; Specialised elements of Communication & Visibility (e.g. websites content, social media material, technical brochures, policy papers etc.) are developed; Technical content and information material linked to all outputs, workshops and trainings are developed and disseminated.

title: SeRANIS Launch Services
description: Der obsiegende Bieter muss für die UniBw M als Launch Service Provider unter anderem folgende Leistungen anbieten:  - Interface Reviews - Maßnahmen zur Gewährleistung der Kompatibilität des Satelliten am Startplatz und während des Starts in Bezug auf Umwelt- und Funkfrequenzbelastungen - Flight / Launch preparation - Launch and deployment of satellite  Die UniBw M behält sich vor, vom Auftragnehmer die Ausführung der folgenden optionalen Leistungen zu verlangen:  - Prüfung der mechanischen und elektronischen Kompatibilität von Launcher und Athene1-Satellit sowie Test des Seperationsmechanismus durch den Auftrag-nehmer an dem Ort der Satellitenintegration vor dem Transport des Satelliten zur Launchsite (Option 1).  - Transportabwicklung und Zollabfertigung. Die Transportabwicklung umfasst die Abholung des Satelliten sowie des notwendigen Zubehörs, insbesondere Mechanical Ground Support Equipment (MGSE) und Electronical Ground Support Equipment (EGSE) inklusive der Nutzlasten bei der UniBw M in Neubiberg, den Transport zum port of arrival, das Logistik-Management bezüglich des Transports zum port of arrival sowie den Rücktransport des MGSE und EGSE nach Neubiberg bzw. zu dem Standort des Herstellers der Satellitenplattform nach Luxemburg (Option 2).  - Lagerung von Xenon und Betankung der Xenon-Tanks des Satelliten an der Launchsite (Option 3).  - Verschieben des Starttermins um bis zu 6 Monate bzw. 12 Monate ("Umbuchung", Option 4)  - Änderung der Launch-Konfiguration: Launch-Konfiguration "Cake Topper" statt der horizontalen Positionierung des Satelliten (Option 5).
